Suraj (Anil Kapoor) and Komal (Karisma Kapoor) are in love with each other and decide to get married without her father’s consent leaving the father daughter relationship sour. However, her father is quite adamant about Suraj’s financial status and sets up a plan to break their marriage apart. Thus, Suraj and Komal get separated until she delivers a baby boy and equations change once again.
